''[&hellip;]''<s></s>''"<br />"''What Council Liaison Nyama means-''"<br />"''Council Liaison Nyama means exactly what he says.|Stromma Council Liaison Nyama and his conciliator|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The '''Stromma council''' was the government of the [[Stromma]] [[Species/Legends|species]], allies of the [[Quesoth]] species. By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], its [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] were [[Nuso Esva's conquests|attacked]] by [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] force, but were [[Battle of Oristrom|liberated]] by the [[Empire of the Hand]]'s [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Bear in mind, too, that Liaison Nyama speaks for the Stromma council, and some of those members still blame us for the destruction their worlds suffered.|Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The [[Stromma]] council was the Stromma [[Species/Legends|species']] government. A number of [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOCO">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Oristrom system/Legends|Oristrom system]]</ref> planet [[Oristrom]]&mdash;the Stromma [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]&mdash;were under the jurisdiction of the council. [[Stromma Council Liaison|Stromma council liaisons]] spoke for the government.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==History==
{{Quote|Your obsession with art, Grand Admiral Thrawn, is more unsettling than your obsession with Nuso Esva himself.''"<br />"''His obsession with both is what drove Nuso Esva off Oristrom and gave you the freedom to be here today.|Stromma Council Liaison Nyama and [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]]|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
[[File:Thrawn-TCGboxart.png|thumb|right|300px|Grand Admiral Thrawn helped the Stromma council in its conflict with Nuso Esva.]]
By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Crisis of FaithD">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] per ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''. As [[Nuso Esva]] had [[Nuso Esva's conquests|attacked]] the [[Stromma]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of ''Crisis of Faith''{{'s}} events, Esva must have attacked them by 8 ABY.</ref> the [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] [[Nuso Esva's conquests|attacked]] the Stromma council's worlds, including Oristrom. On the latter world, the Stromma had the upper hand in a [[Battle of Oristrom|battle]] against Esva's forces until the warlord returned to Oristrom and assumed personal [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of his forces. However, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Empire of the Hand]] was able to drive the Storm-hair off the Stromma homeworld after studying some art. Although Thrawn's empire had helped the Stromma council in their struggle against Esva, some of the government's members blamed the Empire of the Hand for the destruction their worlds had suffered. Other Stromma joined the Empire of the Hand as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the Imperial [[Stromma contingent]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

In 8 ABY,<ref name="Crisis of FaithD" /> the council sent Stromma Council Liaison [[Nyama]] and his [[Nyama's conciliator|conciliator]] to the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'' to discuss an [[Attack on the Red City|attack]] on Esva, who was hiding on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="EAOCQ">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> planet [[Quethold]], homeworld of the [[Quesoth]] species. After Thrawn explained that he would use his stormtroopers to [[Attack on the Red City|defeat]] Esva's [[Quesoth Soldier]]s, Nyama withdrew all Stromma from Imperial service, as he believed that the Quesoth could not be defeated by stormtroopers and that the Stromma stormtroopers would [[Death/Legends|die]] for nothing. The liaison remarked that the Stromma council would not risk its [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] in Thrawn's "mad attack."<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Stromma council was mentioned in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
